name: RapidFEM
tagline: Electromagnetic FEM solver with Rust TD and FD core and Python API.
description: Electromagnetic FEM solver written in Rust, distributed as a Python package on PyPI. Two backends behind one geometry/material/physics API: a frequency-domain solver (second-kind Nedelec edge elements, complex-symmetric sparse linear algebra) and a time-domain DGTD solver (discontinuous Galerkin, Krylov/ETD exponential time integration, model-order reduction). Optional Flask-based local UI with a code editor and live geometry viewer.
